Country.evidence_source: After ethics approval was received from Southwest University, Chongqing, potential settings were contacted, and all permitted the study. Participants were recruited from four public schools in Wuhan City, Hubei province.

Sample.evidence_source: A total of 1152 questionnaires were included in the present analysis.

Survey method.evidence_source: A pencil-and-paper survey was conducted including 1250 Chinese adolescents girls between 11 and 15 years of age. Before completing the pencil-and-paper survey, adolescents and their legal parent/guardian provided informed consent.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants and data collection methods for a study conducted in Wuhan City, Hubei province, China. A pencil-and-paper survey was administered to 1152 Chinese adolescent girls (aged 11-15) recruited from four public schools. The questionnaire collected information on various topics including body appreciation, weight, and height.
